newsitem.title: SPAIN: Consortium wins Madrid airport lighting contract.
newsitem.headline: Consortium wins Madrid airport lighting contract.

text.p: Spain's airport authority AENA said on Tuesday it had awarded a 4.84 billion peseta contract to install the lighting for its third runway at Madrid's Barajas airport to a consortium comprising OCP, Cobra, Elsan and Sampol.

State airport manager Aeropuertos Espanoles y Navegacion Aerea (AENA) said it had awarded the joint venture between OCP Construcciones, Cobra, Elsan and Sampol because it offered the best guarantee for completion.
AENA has said the third runway, due to be completed in 22 months, will accommodate air traffic demand for the next 15 years and relieve the heavy congestion that now plagues the capital city airport.
